THE JOURNEY AT A GLANCE

Make every
day count.

This 5-day, 4-night safari begins and ends at Kilimanjaro International Airport, taking you through the stunning landscapes of Lake Manyara and the southern Serengeti (Ndutu). Explore Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and witness the spectacular calving season in Ndutu. Your journey also includes iconic highlights such as Ngorongoro Crater, where you’ll have the chance to encounter the legendary Big Five in their natural habitat.

Duration5 days
Published styleComfort
PlanningPersonalised
YOUR TIME IN TANZANIA

Day by day.

01DAY 1Arrival I Arusha

Jambo and welcome to Tanzania!
Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by our driver and transferred to Arusha, marking the official start of your safari adventure. After a brief introduction, you will proceed to your accommodation, where you will hear fascinating stories and learn about the local people and their rich culture—offering a perfect first glimpse of Tanzanian life before your journey into the wilderness begins.

Stay Arusha Planet Lodge

Meals & drinks Dinner (Breakfast & lunch not included) Drinking water (Other drinks not included)

02DAY 2Arusha to Ndutu Area

Begin your day with an early breakfast before setting out on a thrilling wildlife game drive in the Southern Serengeti (Ndutu area) to witness the spectacular wildebeest calving season. Depart from Arusha and journey toward the Ndutu area, where the southern plains of the Serengeti meet the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.

The Ndutu calving season, a pinnacle of the Great Wildebeest Migration, typically takes place from late January to March. During this period, over 400,000 wildebeest calves are born, drawn to the lush, nutrient-rich grasses that flourish after the short rains. The Southern Serengeti and Ndutu transform into a vibrant nursery, where newborns are safeguarded—and hunted—amid the presence of predators such as lions, cheetahs, and hyenas.

After an immersive day tracking the herds, a packed lunch will be served at a scenic picnic spot within the park. As the day draws to a close, you’ll return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.

Stay Ndutu Kati Kati Tented Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

03DAY 3Full-Day Safari in the Southern Serengeti

Enjoy a full day in the beautiful Ndutu plains, where wildlife is everywhere you look. During the calving season, the area bursts with new life as thousands of wildebeest welcome their young, while predators like lions and cheetahs roam nearby. Spend the day exploring at your own pace, taking in the sights, sounds, and pure magic of the wild before returning to camp for a peaceful evening under the stars.

Stay Ndutu Kati Kati Tented Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

04DAY 4Ndutu to Ngorongoro Crater

After an early breakfast, depart from the lodge and journey toward the spectacular Ngorongoro Conservation Area.
You’ll descend nearly 600 meters into the legendary Ngorongoro Crater—a UNESCO World Heritage Site often celebrated as the “Garden of Eden.” Spend the day on an unforgettable game drive within this vast natural amphitheater, renowned for its extraordinary concentration of wildlife. Expect encounters with lions, elephants, buffalo, hyenas, the rare black rhino, and vibrant flocks of flamingos coloring the waters of Lake Magadi. A scenic picnic lunch on the crater floor crowns this remarkable experience before you ascend the crater rim.

Stay Tloma Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

05DAY 5Lake Manyara National Park

On your final day, explore the lush landscapes of Lake Manyara National Park, famous for its flamingos, baboons, and tree-climbing lions. Enjoy a morning game drive, taking in the park’s scenic beauty and diverse wildlife. In the evening, depart for Arusha, where you’ll be dropped off at your hotel or the airport, bringing your unforgettable Tanzanian safari to a memorable close.

Meals & drinks Breakfast & lunch (Dinner not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
